lightIdle: Patopato i tētahi wāhitau paetukutuku. Ka tirotirohia tā mātou rārangi mōrearea, te hanganga, ngā tāraire waitohu, te DNS me te urupare ora. Ki te Tū: wehe, whakamana mā tētahi hongere ōkawa kua whakapono kē koe, kātahi ka pūrongo mēnā e hiahia ana.
lightLimited: Ko Mahea te tikanga kāore he whakatūpato kaha i ngā tirotiro kua rere — ehara i te kī taurangi kei te haumaru te pae.
privacyNote: Taunoa: kāore he mea e puritia. Hei whakatika raru hangarau anake ngā tātaritanga — kāore rawa te wāhitau, kāore hoki mō te tuku tūmatanui.
privacyPolicyIntro: Ka āwhina te buusdo Cybersecurity Service Tool (rārangi hua Buusdo — hua motuhake) i a koe ki te tirotiro wāhitau paetukutuku i mua i tō whakapono. Ka whakamahi ngā tirotiro i ngā tohu taha-tuatahi me tā mātou rārangi mōrearea kua āta kōwhiria. Ko tēnei whārangi te pānui tūmataiti hua mō te paetukutuku, te toronga pūtirotiro, me te taupānga papamahi.
privacyPolicyWhatTitle: He aha tā te tirotiro e whakamahi
privacyPolicyWhatBody: Ina ka rere tētahi tirotiro, ka tukatukahia te wāhitau i tāurua ki te tūmau buusdo hei wehewehe hanganga, hei whakataurite ki tā mātou rārangi mōrearea, ā, hei torotoro hoki i te taea-ora (DNS / HTTP) mēnā e hiahia ana. Kāore mātou e tuku URL kua tirohia ki Google Safe Browsing, ki ētahi API rongonui rōpū-tuatoru rānei, kāore hoki e hoko raraunga tirotiro.
privacyPolicyStoreBody: Taunoa: kāore he mea e puritia. Ka taea e koe te kōwhiri i te puringa pūrere-nei-anake (rārangi ārai/whakapono, hītori tirotiro kōwhiringa) i te pūtirotiro, te toronga, te taupānga papamahi rānei. Ko ngā tātaritanga tautoko kōwhiringa he pūtake me te momo mōrearea anake — kāore rawa te wāhitau katoa, kāore hoki mō te tuku tūmatanui, mō te pānui rānei.
privacyPolicyAccountBody: Kāore te buusdo e tuku pūkete kapua, tukutahi rārangi whakawhiti-pūrere rānei. Ka noho ngā rārangi ārai/whakapono whaiaro ki tēnei pūrere. Nekeneke mā te kaweake/kaweake mai i te JSON shield-lists-v1, te QR rānei, tukatuka rānei i te kōnae papamahi shield-backup.json e koe anō (USB, Drive, Syncthing).
privacyPolicyContactBody: Mō ngā pātai tūmataiti, hua rānei, whakapā ki te kaiwhakahaere o tō tāutatanga buusdo mā tō rātou īmēra ōkawa, hongere tautoko rānei (te tangata, te whakahaere rānei e whakahaere ana i te Cloudflare Worker). Whakamahia taua wāhitau ōkawa e mōhiotia ana — kaua he waea, he īmēra rānei i tāia ki te pae e tirohia ana e koe. Kaua e whakapiri ngā hua tirotiro tairongo ki ngā hongere tūmatanui.
privacyPolicyLimitsBody: Kāore he wetewete TLS — ko te ingoa tūāpapa anake te HTTPS CONNECT; kāore he tiwhikete MITM. Kāore he patunga tukanga — ka rere tonu ngā papatono. Pūrongo-anake ngā kōpaki pūnaha — kāore /usr, /etc, ngā ara pūnaha Windows, me Program Files e nukuhia, e whakatikahia rānei. Kāore he pūkaha AV / waitohu, kāore hoki he hopu mōtika uru, hītori tirotiro rānei.
desktopDownloadsIntro: Tāuta i te buusdo ki tēnei rorohiko mai i te GitHub Release (anga pūtirotiro + paepae). Kāore ngā hanga i waitohua — tirohia te aratohu tautuhi. Ka waiho te whakatuwhera-i-te-takiuru kia weto kia whakakāngia e koe.
desktopDownloadUnsignedUntilPromote: Hanga kāore i waitohua (kāore i notarized). Tērā pea ka ārai te macOS i te whakatuwheratanga tuatahi — whāia te aratohu (xattr / Tūmataiti me te Haumarutanga). Tērā pea ka whakatūpato te Windows SmartScreen i te kaiputa kāore i mōhiotia.
desktopDownloadReadyToPromote: Tuhipoka tawhito: kāore te whakatairanga notarized e whakamahia i tēnei huarahi tuku — puritia te zip GitHub kāore i waitohua hei mea matua.
privacyDesktopMirrorNote: Tango iho macOS papamahi: kei te ora te whakaata CDN; ko GitHub Release tonu te hokinga kua tuhia.
claim: E kī ana tēnei paetukutuku ko…
privacy: Ka noho tēnei tirotiro ki tēnei rorohiko. Kāore e puritia te hītori tirotiro.
invalid: Tāurua he wāhitau paetukutuku HTTP, HTTPS rānei e tika ana.
limits: Ngā mea kāore e mōhio tēnei tirotiro
ignoreRiskTitle: Mēnā ka waiho e koe tēnei whakatūpato
ignoreRiskBody: Tērā pea ka hoatu e koe ngā kupu huna, ngā taipitopito utu, ētahi raraunga whaiaro rānei ki te hunga e whakahaere ana i tēnei wāhitau. Katia te ripa i mua i te patopato, i te utu rānei.
nextStepLeave: Wehe ināianei i tēnei whārangi — kaua e haere tonu i te wāhitau i tirohia e koe.
nextStepNoCredentials: Kaua e tāuru kupu huna, nama kāri, waehere nō SMS/īmēra, ētahi raraunga whaiaro rānei ki tēnei pae.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Whakamana motuhake: whakatuwheratia te rohe, te taupānga rānei ōkawa o te whakahaere kua whakapono kē koe (tohuwhārangi, kāri pēke, toa taupānga e mōhiotia ana). Kaua e whakamahi waea, īmēra rānei i te whārangi whakapātaritari.
nextStepReport: Kōwhiringa: tiakina he hukihuki pūrongo paetata i raro nei kia arotake te kaiwhakahaere i te tūāpapa mō te rārangi mōrearea kua āta kōwhiria.
nextStepBlock: Kōwhiringa: ārai te tūāpapa i te toronga, i te taupānga papamahi rānei buusdo kia uaua ake te whakatuwhera anō mā te hē.
nextStepLooksReal: He ātaahua ngā whārangi tinihanga, ka whakamahi HTTPS hoki. Ehara te kounga tirohanga i te tohu kei te tika te pae.
honestLimitsTitle: Ngā tepenga pono o tēnei taputapu
honestLimitNoWipe: Kāore e taea e buusdo te muku mōhiohio whaiaro kua kohia kētia e tētahi pae. Whakawhitia ngā kupu huna i te pae ōkawa tūturu mēnā i tāuru koe i tētahi mea, ā, mātai ngā whakamōhiotanga pēke/īmēra.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Ka ahu mai ngā hua i te rārangi kua āta kōwhiria me ngā tohu wāhitau a buusdo — ehara i te tatau pōti tūmatanui e hia ngā tāngata i tohu i te pae.
honestLimitNoAv: Ehara tēnei i te hua paturopi. Ko te kati i te ripa ka whakamutu i te tāuru raraunga anō ki konei; kāore e matawai, e horoi rānei i tō pūrere.
actionSensitiveNote: Kaua e tāuru mōhiohio tairongo kia taea rā anō e koe te whakaū i te wāhitau mā tētahi pūtake motuhake.

faqParentsTitle: Mō ngā mātua me ngā kaiako
faqParentsIntro: Ngā whakautu poto mō ngā mahi, ngā mahi-kore hoki a tēnei taputapu — he pai i mua i tō tono ki te ākonga, ki te tamaiti rānei kia whakapono ki tētahi hua Tū.
faqNoWipeTitle: Ka taea e buusdo te muku raraunga kua riro kē i te pae?
faqNoWipeBody: Kāo. Whakawhitia ngā kupu huna i te pae ōkawa tūturu mēnā i tāurua tētahi mea, ā, mātai ngā whakamōhiotanga pēke, īmēra rānei.
faqNoAvBody: Kāo. Ko te kati i te ripa ka whakamutu i te tāuru raraunga anō ki tērā wāhitau; kāore e matawai, e horoi rānei i te pūrere.
faqNoCrowdTitle: Ka ahu mai te kaute i ngā pōti a ētahi atu kaiwhakamahi?
faqNoCrowdBody: Kāo. Ka whakamahi ngā hua i te rārangi mōrearea kua āta kōwhiria me ngā tohu wāhitau a buusdo — ehara i te tatau tūmatanui “e hia ngā tāngata i tohu”.

blockListsOfflinePath: Huarahi whakawhiti-pūrere: kaweake/kaweake mai i te JSON shield-lists-v1, te QR rānei i te toronga, i te taupānga papamahi rānei. Ka taea hoki e te papamahi te tukatuka shield-backup.json mā USB, Drive, Syncthing rānei — kāore he pūkete kapua.

listsOfflineDesktopBody: Ka tiakina e te taupānga papamahi ngā rārangi hei shield-backup.json i tōna kōpaki raraunga. Ka taea e koe te tukatuka i tērā kōpaki ki Syncthing, Drive, USB rānei. Mēnā ka tuhi ngā pūrere e rua i te wā kotahi, kaweake anō mai i te pūrere e whakapono ana koe, kaweake mai ki tērā atu.

localeRecommendBody: I runga i tō pūtirotiro, e tūtohua ana e mātou a {lang}. Ka taea te huri i ngā wā katoa i te pane.
whyEmpty: Kāore he tohu kaha ake i tua atu i ngā tepenga auau.
levelCriticalNote: E tohu ana ngā taunakitanga kaha me wehe koe i mua i te tāuru mōhiohio.
levelHighNote: He maha ngā tohu whakatūpato kua tuhia e hiahia ana i te aro ināianei.
levelCautionNote: I kitea he rangirua nui, he tohu whakatūpato rānei.
levelLowEvidenceNote: Kāore he mōrearea e mōhiotia ana i ngā pūtake i tirohia.
levelUnknownNote: Kāore i nui ngā taunakitanga mō tētahi whakatau pūmau.
reputationNoKnownMatch: KĀORE HE ŌRITE E MŌHIOTIA ANA
reputationProviderUnavailable: KĀORE TE RĀRANGI I TE WĀTEA
recommendationLeaveAndBlock: Wehe, ārai hoki i tēnei rohe (i te toronga, i te taupānga papamahi rānei)
desktopBlockNeedOpen: Whakatuwheratia te taupānga papamahi buusdo i te tuatahi (localhost:3010), ngana anō.
evidenceKnownThreatDetail: I ōrite tēnei wāhitau ki te rārangi mōrearea ake a buusdo.
evidenceNoMatchTitle: Kāore he mōrearea e mōhiotia ana i ngā rārangi
evidenceNoMatchDetail: Kāore he mōrearea e mōhiotia ana i te rārangi ake. Ehara tērā i te tohu kei te haumaru te pae.
evidenceUnknownReputationDetail: Kāore te rārangi ake e tuku hua pai, kino rānei.
evidenceProviderUnavailableTitle: Kāore te rārangi mōrearea i te wātea
evidenceProviderUnavailableDetail: Kāore i taea te pānui i te rārangi ake. I haere tonu ngā tirotiro hanganga me te ora.
evidenceIdentityMatchTitle: Ka ōrite te rohe ki tētahi whakahaere e mōhiotia ana
evidenceIdentityMatchDetail: Ka ōrite te rohe rēhita ki a {name}. Ehara tērā i te tikanga kei te haumaru te pae.
evidenceIdentityMismatchTitle: He āhua rite ki tētahi whakahaere e mōhiotia ana, engari kāore te rohe e ōrite
evidenceIdentityMismatchDetail: He āhua pā ana te wāhitau ki a {name}, engari ko te rohe whakahaere ko {domain}.
evidenceMisleadingSubdomainDetail: Ka puta tētahi ingoa rite ki tētahi whakahaere i mua i te rohe whakahaere {domain}.
evidenceLookalikeDetail: He rite tēnei rohe ki tētahi rohe e mōhiotia ana. He tohu te ōrite, ehara i te taunakitanga tinihanga.
evidencePunycodeDetail: Kei te wāhitau he punycode. Tērā pea he tika, engari me tūpato ki ngā pūāhua rite.
evidenceHttpDetail: Tērā pea ka kitea ngā mōhiohio i tukuna mā HTTP i te huarahi.
evidenceSensitivePathDetail: E tohu ana te ara tērā pea ka pātai te whārangi i ētahi mōhiohio tairongo. Whakaū i te rohe mā te motuhake.
evidenceDnsOkDetail: I tae te tirotiro ora ki te tūāpapa.
evidenceDnsFailTitle: Kāore i tae ki te tūāpapa
evidenceDnsFailDetail: Kāore te tūāpapa i whakautu. Tērā pea i hē te patopato, kāore rānei e taea.
evidenceRedirectChainDetail: I whai te tono i tētahi, i ētahi rānei ngā whakahoki.
evidenceCrossRedirectDetail: I whakahokia te wāhitau ki tētahi rohe rēhita kē.
evidenceRedirectDetail: I whai te tono i tētahi whakahoki.
evidenceTlsFailDetail: Kāore i taea te whakaū HTTPS. Kaua e tāuru mōhiohio tairongo.
evidenceIpHostDetail: Ka tae ki te pae mā te IP, ehara mā te ingoa rohe noa.
evidenceRiskyTldDetail: Ka nui ake te whakamahi o tēnei whakamutunga i ngā kaupapa tinihanga. Ko tōna kotahi kāore e tohu kino.
evidenceDeepSubdomainDetail: I ētahi wā ka whakamahia ngā mehameha rohe-iti roa kia āhua ōkawa te āhua.
evidenceSecretQueryDetail: Ka whakatakoto te wāhitau i tētahi mea ngaro ki te pātai. Kāore te uara i puritia.
evidenceProbeTimeoutTitle: I pau te wā o te tirotiro ora
evidenceProbeTimeoutDetail: Kāore te pae i whakautu i te wā.
evidenceHttpsLimitTitle: Kāore te HTTPS e tohu tuakiri, whakapono rānei
evidenceHttpsLimitDetail: Ka tiaki te HTTPS i te hononga, engari kāore e tohu ko wai e whakahaere ana i te pae, e whakapono rānei.
evidenceScopeLimitDetail: Ka tātari mātou i te wāhitau ki te rārangi ake, ngā waitohu tāraire, DNS, te taea, me ngā whakahoki. Kāore mātou e tuku i te URL ki ngā ratonga rōpū-tuatoru.
evidenceUserBlockDetail: Kei tō rārangi whaiaro tēnei tūāpapa (toronga, taupānga rānei). Kāore te pae i puritia te rārangi.
limitationFalsePosNeg: Tērā pea ka puta ngā tohu i ngā hua-pai-hē, i ngā hua-kino-hē rānei.
limitationNoContent: Kāore tēnei tirotiro e tātari i te ihirangi whārangi, e tohu rānei ko wai e whakahaere ana i tētahi rohe.
limitationIdentityNotSafe: Kāore te ōrite tuakiri e kī taurangi kei te haumaru ngā mahi katoa i tētahi pae.
limitationNoThirdParty: Kāore ngā URL e tukuna ki Google Safe Browsing, ki ētahi atu ratonga rongonui rōpū-tuatoru rānei.
riskLevelCriticalNote: E tohu ana ngā taunakitanga kaha me wehe koe i mua i te tāuru mōhiohio.
riskLevelHighNote: He maha ngā tohu whakatūpato kua tuhia e hiahia ana i te aro ināianei.
riskLevelCautionNote: I kitea he rangirua nui, he tohu whakatūpato rānei.
riskLevelLowEvidenceNote: Kāore he mōrearea e mōhiotia ana i ngā pūtake i tirohia.
riskLevelUnknownNote: Kāore i nui ngā taunakitanga mō tētahi whakatau pūmau.
recommendLeaveAndBlock: Wehe, ārai hoki i tēnei rohe (i te toronga, i te taupānga papamahi rānei)
probeBlockedGenericDetail: Received HTTP {status}. The site blocked or throttled this check — that is not proof of phishing. Try the address in a normal browser if needed.
